note: Multiple cohorts demonstrate two distinct subtypes of isolated CLN3 retinal degeneration: an earlier-onset form with early macular atrophy, and a late-onset form showing foveal sparing of the ellipsoid zone and outer nuclear layer without early macular atrophy.

evidence.text: Among 10 patients with isolated CLN3 disease, 6 had early-onset rod-cone dystrophy while 4 had late-onset disease, with OCT imaging showing significant photoreceptor loss except in late-onset patients who exhibited focal preservation of the foveal ellipsoid zone and outer nuclear layer.

source.title: Detailed Clinical Phenotype and Molecular Genetic Findings in CLN3-Associated Isolated Retinal Degeneration
source.quote: Optical coherence tomography imaging demonstrated significant photoreceptor loss except in patients with late-onset disease who had a focal preservation of the ellipsoid zone and outer nuclear layer in the fovea.

numbers.metric: patients with late-onset disease preserving foveal EZ/ONL

evidence.text: Evaluation of 15 patients with isolated CLN3-associated retinal degeneration identified two distinct presentations: a mild rod-cone dystrophy of middle-age onset (n=6) and a severe dystrophy with early macular atrophic changes (n=9).

source.title: Retinal Phenotype of Patients With Isolated Retinal Degeneration Due to CLN3 Pathogenic Variants in a French Retinitis Pigmentosa Cohort
source.quote: Two distinct patterns of retinal disease could be identified: a mild rod-cone degeneration of middle-age onset (n = 6; legal blindness threshold reached by 70s) and a severe retinal degeneration with early macular atrophic changes (n = 9; legal blindness threshold reached by 40s).

numbers.metric: severe retinal degeneration with early macular atrophic changes
